_comment: How translate_calls.py rewrites calls from OoT (SoH) signatures to 2Ship's. Argument indexes refer to the OoT call. Functions whose signatures differ but have no rule here are listed in docs/SIGNATURES.md.

Matrix_ToMtx.note: OoT passes debug file and line

PadMgr_Init.note: MM's PadMgr is a single global

PadMgr_RumbleSet.note: MM's PadMgr is a single global

PadMgr_RumbleStop.note: MM's PadMgr is a single global

Actor_SetDropFlag.note: MM takes a ColliderElement and no third argument

EffectSsDFire_Spawn.note: MM adds an s16 before the last argument

EffectSsDeadDb_Spawn.note: MM takes two Color_RGBA8 pointers instead of separate components

EffectSsDeadDd_Spawn.note: MM takes two Color_RGBA8 pointers instead of separate components

Inventory_ChangeEquipment.note: MM takes only the equipment slot

TitleCard_InitBossName.note: MM takes GameState and no last argument
